text: Farlaama e mo'on si maande maayde nden arii goɗɗo e mo'on, si tawii himo acci jawle nde o wasiyaŋtoo jibinɓe mo ɓen e ɓadondiraaɓe ɓen kon ko shari'a on happi -ɗum non wanaa yo fawu tataɓal jawdi ndin- Waɗugol ɗum ko hannduyee fellitanaaɗo gomɗuɓe ɓen (huli Alla). Ndee ñaawoore no woodunoo ado aayeeje ndonndi nden jippaade. Ko nde aayeeje ndoondi ɗen jippinoo ɗe ɓaŋngini ɓen ronooɓe maayɗo on e yeru ko ɓe ronata.
